intro: The shrug kaomoji ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ — the "smugshrug" — is the classic text face for "I don't know" and "whatever." It is plain Unicode text (the katakana ツ makes the face), so it pastes cleanly into Slack, Discord, chat, comments, and bios with no image. Browse the classic shrug plus indifferent, confused, and Lenny shrug variants below and click any to copy it instantly.
